claim_boundary: Finite-height normalization, the half-weight at y=1, sharp convergence away from the jump, and exact reduction to an absolutely convergent squared-denominator Fourier integral are Lean-verified. The classical value of that final integral remains unproved; no RH progress or novel mathematics is claimed.
verified_units: positive vertical line avoids the pole at zero
complex power equals the exponential-logarithmic kernel for y > 0
finite-height y-form equals the a = log(y) oscillatory form
the constant exp(a*c) factors exactly from the finite-height integral
the scalar and logarithmic open targets are logically equivalent
all finite scalar truncations are interval integrable
at y = 1 the raw integral equals 2*arctan(T/c)
at y = 1 the normalized symmetric limit is 1/2

open_unit.statement_shape: Evaluate the absolutely convergent integral of exp(i*a*t)/(c+i*t)^2 as 2*pi*a*exp(-a*c) for a > 0 and zero for a < 0.
open_unit.why_open: Lean now proves that this single whole-line Fourier value implies the original conditional Perron limit. It still requires a checked Fourier-inversion, Laplace/Fubini, or contour evaluation.
